# ChatWorkspace > A chat that floats as an island over the content or pins beside it as a resizable column, without remounting. This file matches the installed `chat-workspace` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version. ## Install ```bash npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/chat-workspace.json ``` With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/chat-workspace.md`. ## npm dependencies - `lucide-react@^1.78.0` ## Registry dependencies - `button` - `core` - `motion` - `view-transition` ## Exports - `@/components/control-ui/chat-workspace-fold`: `foldPanel` - `@/components/control-ui/chat-workspace-resize-handle`: `ChatWorkspaceResizeHandle`, types `ChatWorkspaceResizeHandleProps` - `@/components/control-ui/chat-workspace-state`: `ChatWorkspaceContext`, `ChatWorkspaceElementsContext`, `useChatWorkspace`, `useChatWorkspaceElements`, `useControllableState`, `clamp`, types `ChatWorkspaceSide`, `ChatWorkspacePresentation`, `ChatWorkspaceContextValue`, `ChatWorkspaceElements` - `@/components/control-ui/chat-workspace`: `ChatWorkspaceResizeHandle`, `useChatWorkspace`, `ChatWorkspace`, `ChatWorkspaceMain`, `ChatWorkspacePanel`, `ChatWorkspaceInset`, `ChatWorkspaceCollapsible`, `ChatWorkspaceExpandToggle`, `ChatWorkspaceDockToggle`, types `ChatWorkspaceResizeHandleProps`, `ChatWorkspaceContextValue`, `ChatWorkspacePresentation`, `ChatWorkspaceSide`, `ChatWorkspaceProps`, `ChatWorkspaceMainProps`, `ChatWorkspacePanelProps`, `ChatWorkspaceInsetProps`, `ChatWorkspaceCollapsibleProps`, `ChatWorkspaceExpandToggleProps`, `ChatWorkspaceDockToggleProps` ## Composition ### Floating or pinned chat ```tsx page content ``` ## Usage ```tsx "use client"; import { ArrowUp } from "lucide-react"; import { ChatComposer, ChatComposerShell, ChatComposerSubmit, ChatComposerTextarea, ChatComposerToolbar, } from "@/components/control-ui/chat-composer"; import { ChatLayout, ChatLayoutActions, ChatLayoutHeader, ChatLayoutTitle, ChatThread, ChatThreadScrollButton, ChatTurn, } from "@/components/control-ui/chat-layout"; import { ChatMessage, ChatMessageBody, ChatMessageContent, ChatMessageRow } from "@/components/control-ui/chat-message"; import { ChatWorkspace, ChatWorkspaceCollapsible, ChatWorkspaceDockToggle, ChatWorkspaceExpandToggle, ChatWorkspaceInset, ChatWorkspaceMain, ChatWorkspacePanel, ChatWorkspaceResizeHandle, } from "@/components/control-ui/chat-workspace"; import { ScrollArea } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/scroll-area"; const sections = [ "A workspace keeps the conversation next to the thing it is about.", "Floating, the chat is a small island over the bottom of the page: collapse it to just the composer when you want the room.", "Pinned, it becomes a column at the side that you can drag wider or narrower, or resize from the keyboard with the arrow keys.", "Switching between the two never remounts the chat, so a half-written message and the scroll position in the transcript stay put.", "When the space is too narrow for a column, the chat keeps floating and the pin button steps aside.", ]; const turns = [ { id: "ask", from: "user" as const, text: "Summarise what changed in this draft." }, { id: "answer", from: "assistant" as const, text: "You tightened the intro and moved the examples after the rules." }, ]; export function ChatWorkspaceExample() { return (

Selector pattern: `[data-skin="{skin}"] :where([data-slot="{part}"][data-control-family="{family}"])`. - `chat-workspace` - `collapsible` - `inset` - `main` - `panel` - `resize-handle` - `resize-shield` - `root`: `data-docked`, `data-expanded`, `data-side` (`left` | `right`) ## Knobs Registered `--cui-*` custom properties with their recipe defaults. Set them through the component's `style` prop or a skin. ### chat-workspace - `--cui-chat-workspace-gap`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 3)` - `--cui-chat-workspace-island-max-inline-size`: `44rem` - `--cui-chat-workspace-transcript-block-size`: `28rem` - `--cui-chat-workspace-background`: `var(--card)` - `--cui-chat-workspace-foreground`: `var(--card-foreground)` - `--cui-chat-workspace-border-color`: `var(--border)` - `--cui-chat-workspace-border-width`: `var(--control-rim-width)` - `--cui-chat-workspace-radius`: `max( var(--radius-panel), calc(var(--radius-composer) + var(--composer-padding) + var(--cui-chat-workspace-border-width)) )` - `--cui-chat-workspace-shadow`: `var(--shadow-pop)` - `--cui-chat-workspace-handle-background`: `oklch(from var(--foreground) l c h / 0.3)` ## Links - Online docs (latest release): https://control-ui.dev/kits/chat-workspace - Anatomy contract: https://control-ui.dev/r/contract/chat-workspace.json
